apps.name: Noop Aura
apps.subtitle: A local-first companion for your WHOOP strap.
apps.localizedDescription:
Noop Aura reads a WHOOP 4.0 or 5.0/MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth and stores its scores, history, goals and coach memory locally by default. The optional Coach sends only consented data categories to the provider you configure; opt-in proactive summaries may contact that provider in the background. Exports, backups and Apple Health access remain under your control.

The iPhone/iPad IPA is unsigned on purpose and includes Home and Lock Screen widgets plus the live heart-rate Live Activity.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Noop Aura connects directly to your WHOOP strap to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery and sensor data on your iPhone. Sharing occurs only through an export, backup, Apple Health write or Coach provider you explicitly enable.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Noop Aura reads the Apple Health data types you approve to compute recovery, strain and sleep. They stay local unless you explicitly export, back up or consent to share a category with a configured Coach provider.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Noop Aura writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
